questions.explanation: Deeply nested conditionals can make code difficult to read and understand due to excessive indentation and complex logic paths. They are harder to maintain because changes in one part of the logic may require changes in several places. For example, a series of nested `if` statements can obscure the logic flow, making it difficult to debug. Alternatives include flattening the conditionals into a single `if-else-if` chain or using a `switch` statement for clearer logic.
